tools.name: search_published_guides
tools.description: Use this when a user asks about document translation, Apostille, visas, countries, or institutions covered by Official Translator. Search published public guides in Macedonian and English; returns titles, summaries, language, and source URLs. Fetch the most relevant result before answering.

tools.name: fetch_published_guide
tools.description: Use this after search_published_guides finds a relevant result. Fetch the full text and FAQ of one published Official Translator guide by its slug so you can answer from the source and cite its URL. Draft articles are never returned.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_published_guides" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Use this when a user asks about document translation, Apostille, visas, countries, or institutions covered by Official Translator. Search published public guide…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
